newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME FALLS.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME FALLS.

text.p: Turnover and traded volume fell at Tuesday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange, the exchange said.
Alkaloid joint stock company sold a total of 290 shares at 1,009 and 1,000 denars, below par of 2,424 denars.
Traded volume was 417 shares at the previous session on Tuesday when only Alkaloid stocks traded at 1,010-1,009 denars.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades on Tuesday and Thursday.
